title: Scalar realization of a constant module sheaf and its generators
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site small in the chosen module universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $B$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with $\alpha:\underline R\to B$, where $\underline R$ is the constant commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For an $R$-module $V$, let $\underline V$ be the constant module sheaf [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor], with coefficients transported to the underlying ring sheaf of $\underline R$ by the canonical comparison [def-sfb-constant-module-coefficient-transport]. Define the scalar constant realization $C_B(V)=B\otimes_{\underline R}\underline V$ to be ordinary sheaf change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], a sheaf of $B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an $R$-linear map $f:V\to W$, define $C_B(f)$ by applying this change of rings to the constant module sheaf map. For $U\in\mathcal C$, $b\in B(U)$ and $v\in V$, define its canonical generator $b\otimes v\in C_B(V)(U)$ as the pure-tensor section [def-sfb-scalar-extension-pure-tensor-section] of $b$ and the constant-section unit image of $v$. The generator uses the constant-module sheafification unit followed by the change-of-rings module-sheafification unit. No finite generation, projectivity or flatness is assumed.
